# DeadlineSF
> Multi-jurisdiction AI compliance control plane. Modular law packs, attorney-reviewed packages, verified compliance receipts, and a free plain-English AI Law Library. Not a law firm.

## Doctrine (founder-locked)
- Help first. Everything is built to protect and educate people — never extract first.
- Do not ask for trust. Prove worth by giving something small but valuable away.
- The free 3-line patch IS the pitch, not a brochure.
- Value before invoice. Education before fear. Armor before jargon.
- Public line: "We don't ask for trust. We prove it — with a free fix you can use today."

## API (Netlify functions)
- GET  https://deadlinesf.net/api/laws
- POST https://deadlinesf.net/api/scan
- POST https://deadlinesf.net/api/fulfill        (shared-secret protected)
- POST https://deadlinesf.net/api/create-checkout (body: {"package":"gap_750"|...})
- POST https://deadlinesf.net/api/stripe-webhook  (Stripe endpoint; signature-verified)
